steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。平方根輸出時間；任何不一致的長度或時間單位都須先修正。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. The square root yields time; inconsistent length or time units must be corrected first.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 平方根輸出時間；任何不一致的長度或時間單位都須先修正。
steps.checkEn: The square root yields time; inconsistent length or time units must be corrected first.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 重力粒子積分會依加速度調整步長；本課把連續準則與實際可用的二進位時間階層分開，避免誤報更新頻率。
knowledge.textEn: A gravitational particle integrator adjusts timestep according to acceleration. Separate a continuous accuracy criterion from the available binary timestep hierarchy so that a computed bound is not mistaken for an actual scheduled step.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 使用原創合成資料研究「GADGET-4：加速度步長界與二進位時間階層」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付量綱推導、連續界與排程值對照、向上取整反例與守恆測試計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Investigate GADGET-4: acceleration timestep bounds and binary time hierarchy using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver dimensional derivation, continuous-versus-scheduled timestep tables, an upward-rounding counterexample and a conservation-test plan that records the assumptions excluded from the simplified criterion.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 非宇宙學教學準則 dt=sqrt(2ηε/abs(a))；ε 是軟化長度，η 無因次。實際步長需再符合階層、上限與同步條件。
knowledge.textEn: Use the noncosmological teaching criterion dt=sqrt(2*eta*epsilon/abs(a)), with softening length epsilon and dimensionless eta. The actual scheduled step must additionally satisfy hierarchy, maximum-step and synchronization constraints.

stages.title: 建立量綱與適用範圍
stages.description: 將長度除加速度化為時間平方，確認 η 不帶單位；明示本課非宇宙學，且 ε 不是任意網格寬度。
stages.descriptionEn: Reduce length divided by acceleration to time squared and confirm that eta is dimensionless. State the noncosmological scope and distinguish gravitational softening from an arbitrary mesh spacing or a coordinate conversion that would alter the criterion.
